integrity: The result is derived from a symbolic simplicial decomposition and integral oriented cycles; finite computer checks are corroborative, not an infinite proof. Primary sources were inspected for distinct and stronger formulations.
scientific_limitations: Full homotopy type and integral homology in dimensions one and two remain unclassified; only homology in degrees three and higher and a non-equivariant cofiber are established. An unindexed equivalent formulation is possible.
title: Row–column boundary spheres control higher neighborhood homology of rook graphs
